# spheres_for_atoms { #mofography.visualize.spheres_for_atoms }

`visualize.spheres_for_atoms(ase_atoms, radii=None, scale=0.8, colormap=None, theta_resolution=10, phi_resolution=10)`

It takes an ASE atoms object and returns a list of trimesh objects, each of which is a sphere with
radius and center corresponding to the atom's covalent radius and position.

## Parameters

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                 | Default    |
|-------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `ase_atoms` |        | an ase atoms object                                                                         | _required_ |
| `radii`     |        | the radii of the spheres. If None, the covalent radii from ase.data.covalent_radii are used | `None`     |
| `scale`     |        | the scale of the sphere radius                                                              | `0.8`      |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                |
|--------|----------------------------|
|        | A list of trimesh objects. |
